gold.agent_sql: SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM actor LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM customer LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(DISTINCT name) FROM language LIMIT 100
SELECT   title FROM film WHERE   length > 180 LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   rating = 'R' LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   rental_rate > 4 LIMIT 100
SELECT   first_name,   last_name FROM customer WHERE   last_name LIKE 'B%' LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   length BETWEEN 60 AND 90 LIMIT 100
SELECT   AVG(length) AS average_length FROM film LIMIT 100
SELECT   SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM payment LIMIT 100
SELECT   MAX(rental_rate) AS max_rental_rate,   MIN(rental_rate) AS min_rental_rate FROM film LIMIT 100
SELECT   c.name AS category,   COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_count FROM film_category AS fc JOIN category AS c   ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY   c.category_id,   c.name LIMIT 100
SELECT   c.store_id,   COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customer AS c GROUP BY   c.store_id LIMIT 100
SELECT   title,   length FROM film ORDER BY   length DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT   a.first_name,   a.last_name,   COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor AS a JOIN film_actor AS fa   ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY   a.actor_id ORDER BY   film_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT   c.name AS category,   COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_count FROM film_category AS fc JOIN category AS c   ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY   c.category_id,   c.name ORDER BY   film_count DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT   c.first_name,   c.last_name,   SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent FROM customer AS c JOIN payment AS p   ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY   c.customer_id,   c.first_name,   c.last_name ORDER BY   total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT   co.country AS country,   COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customer AS c JOIN address AS a   ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city AS ci   ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country AS co   ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY   co.country_id,   co.country ORDER BY   customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT   c.first_name,   c.last_name,   COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM customer AS c JOIN rental AS r   ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY   c.customer_id,   c.first_name,   c.last_name ORDER BY   rental_count DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT   f.title FROM film AS f JOIN film_actor AS fa   ON f.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor AS a   ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id WHERE   a.first_name = 'NICK' AND a.last_name = 'WAHLBERG' LIMIT 100
SELECT   f.title,   c.name FROM film AS f JOIN film_category AS fc   ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category AS c   ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE   f.title LIKE 'Z%' LIMIT 100
SELECT   s.store_id,   COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS film_count FROM store AS s JOIN inventory AS i   ON s.store_id = i.store_id GROUP BY   s.store_id LIMIT 100

SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   film_id IN (     SELECT       film_id     FROM film_category     WHERE       category_id = (         SELECT           category_id         FROM category         WHERE           name = 'Comedy'       )   ) LIMIT 100
